How I computed this: WITH active AS (SELECT service_id FROM calendar WHERE wednesday='1' AND '20260916' BETWEEN start_date AND end_date UNION SELECT service_id FROM calendar_dates WHERE date='20260916' AND exception_type='1' EXCEPT SELECT service_id FROM calendar_dates WHERE date='20260916' AND exception_type='2'), typical AS (SELECT trips.trip_id, trips.route_id, trips.shape_id FROM trips JOIN active USING (service_id) JOIN route_patterns rp ON rp.route_pattern_id = trips.route_pattern_id AND rp.route_pattern_typicality='1' WHERE trips.route_id IN (SELECT route_id FROM routes WHERE route_type='3')), ref_stop AS (SELECT st.stop_id FROM stop_times st JOIN typical USING (trip_id) GROUP BY st.stop_id HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(*) FROM typical) ORDER BY min(st.stop_sequence::int) LIMIT 1), dep AS (SELECT st.trip_id, split_part(st.departure_time, ':', 1)::int*60 + split_part(st.departure_time, ':', 2)::int AS mins FROM stop_times st JOIN typical USING (trip_id) WHERE st.stop_id = (SELECT stop_id FROM ref_stop)), gaps AS (SELECT trip_id, mins, mins - lag(mins) OVER (PARTITION BY trip_id ORDER BY mins) AS headway FROM dep), headways AS (SELECT r.route_id, COALESCE(r.route_short_name, r.route_long_name) AS route_name, median(g.headway) AS median_headway_min FROM gaps g JOIN typical t USING (trip_id) JOIN routes r ON t.route_id = r.route_id WHERE g.headway IS NOT NULL AND g.mins >= 7*60 AND g.mins < 9*60 GROUP BY r.route_id, r.route_short_name, r.route_long_name HAVING median(g.headway) <= 10) SELECT DISTINCT shape_id, route_name AS label, median_headway_min AS value FROM headways JOIN typical ON headways.route_id = typical.route_id ORDER BY median_headway_min.
